states.narration: Both products contain a factor of 2. Keep x and y in their original order.
Collect the two copies of 2 into one factor of the sum. Distributing recovers 2x and 2y.

editorial.title: Twice each, or twice the sum
editorial.setup: Two copies of x plus two copies of y can be grouped as twice their sum.
editorial.summary: Factoring changes the grouping, not the value. Distribute the 2 to check each original product.
